name: aplomb-1
description:
Aplomb 1 is EmpirioLabs' decision model. Ask a question about your text, images, or video, and it answers with a calibrated probability, such as "Yes (97%)", instead of generated text. Set Answer Type to Choice to pick one of your options, or to Score to rate on a scale. It accepts text, image, and video input with a 1M token context.

Weight Precision: BF16

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
